question: Will Microsoft's unified Agent Framework (merging Semantic Kernel's enterprise features with AutoGen's multi-agent orchestration, shipped April 2026 under Microsoft.Agents.AI) reach a stable v1.0 release by 2026-12-31?
resolution_criteria: Check the project's official release notes/GitHub releases on 2026-12-31. Resolves YES if a release explicitly tagged 1.0 (or described as stable/GA, not preview/beta) exists by that date.
reasoning: Merging two previously separate frameworks (Semantic Kernel, AutoGen) into one SDK is a large surface-area change; Microsoft has historically taken multiple preview cycles to stabilize major SDK rewrites. An 8-month window from initial ship to GA is plausible but not clearly favored either way.
